'''Esne''' is a [[servant]] in the [[Aesdaishar Palace]] in [[Chachin]].

==Appearance==
Esne is a young woman with a square face.{{ref/book|0|22}}

==History==
Esne was assigned as the servant of [[Lan Mandragoran]] when he came to the Palace in {{ne|979}}.{{ref/book|0|22}} She was present when [[Moiraine Damodred]] came to call on Lan after he had arrived.{{ref/book|0|25}} After a little searching, Lan discovers that Esne is loyal to [[Edeyn Arrel]].{{ref/book|0|26}}
